title: Gowers norm one iff bounded degree
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function and let $d$ be a nonnegative integer, and write $(-1)^f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{\pm 1\}$ for its sign lift. Then the $2^{d+1}$-th power of the order-$(d+1)$ Gowers uniformity norm of $(-1)^f$ equals $1$,
\[
  \|(-1)^f\|_{U^{d+1}}^{2^{d+1}} = 1,
\]
if and only if $(-1)^f$ has degree at most $d$, meaning that for every base point $x \in \{0,1\}^n$ and all direction vectors $h_1,\ldots,h_{d+1} \in \{0,1\}^n$ the $(d+1)$-fold Gowers product $\mathrm{GP}\big((-1)^f, d{+}1, x, h_1,\ldots,h_{d+1}\big)$ equals $1$.
hypotheses_covered: the statement concerns the pm1 lift (-1)^f
order d+1 Gowers norm raised to the 2^(d+1) power
